summary: Split h_c k into 𝖴 and 𝖧 parts, approximate the 𝖴 part rationally and write the 𝖧 part through a class representative.

steps.claim: Let σ be the reduction of k ∈ 𝖲 ∩ K. Then h_c k ∈ 𝖲 (𝖧 ⊆ 𝖲), so h_c k = u·h with u ∈ 𝖴 and h ∈ 𝖧 = image of inclHFin, h = inclHFin(g) (mem_besselS, range_inclHFin).
